author: China Insights
description:
The 2026 U.S. midterm elections are almost here—and Donald Trump is fighting to keep Republicans in control of Congress.

After weeks of nonstop campaigning, Trump is delivering an urgent message: Republicans must win. But election forecasts and prediction markets suggest Democrats may have a real chance to take back the House, while control of the Senate remains fiercely contested.

So what happens if Trump loses one chamber—or both?

In this episode, we break down the battle for all 435 House seats, the Senate races that could determine Washington's balance of power, and the political consequences for the final two years of Trump's presidency.

We examine the Democratic Party's potential electoral wave, Republican redistricting strategies, the impact of inflation and living costs, and the key races in Texas, North Carolina, Ohio, Maine, Kansas, and Michigan.

title: Trump Is Fighting to Save Congress. Could the Midterms End His Agenda?
